pages.title: The Spit Turns
pages.text: Collect a completed edible portion from a Shawarma Spit.

pages.title: The Spit Turns
pages.text: Learn controlled roasting as a separate technique.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Use the Spit’s native redstone controls; stop it before collecting a finished portion. Raw input does not count.

pages.title: Power a roasting tower
pages.text: The roasting tower uses suitable foods and redstone. Stop it before taking a portion, because the powered hot device can burn you.
